mcp_instructions.admin: This MCP server is the shared task and worktree source of truth for a Codex team. For an initialized team project, call team_cluster_ensure before non-trivial development work so every project has one persistent cluster goal. Then call team_status or team_list_tasks before planning; reuse existing tasks when possible. The lead creates tasks, creates a worktree for every write task, assigns a role, and is the only reviewer allowed to mark tasks done. Workers must claim a task, keep its claim_token private, send heartbeats, and submit to review with commit and test evidence. Never edit outside an assigned worktree.
mcp_instructions.core_full: This MCP server is the shared Team Board task and worktree source. Use only the stable `team_read` and `team_write` tools. Call team_read(operation='help') once after initialization to discover the available operations and argument names. Keep claim tokens private, never edit outside an assigned worktree, and preserve the Lead-only review rules.
mcp_instructions.core_read_only: This MCP server is the shared Team Board read-only source. Use only the stable `team_read` tool. Call team_read(operation='help') once after initialization to discover read operations. Do not attempt claims, reviews, archive operations, or any other Team Board mutation.
mcp_instructions.disabled: The Codex Team Board MCP surface is disabled for this session. No Team Board tools are available.
